{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_prediction_markets_20260517",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "price_range",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The absolute spread between the highest and lowest price, representing the total price movement.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "volatility",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct, continuous measure of market volatility, which is highly informative for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "high - low"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_open_to_high_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled ratio of the upward price movement from the open price, normalized by the open price.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative upward momentum in a smooth, log-compressed scale suitable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p((high - open) / np.maximum(open, 0.001))"
    },
    {
      "name": "open_to_low_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the downward price movement from the open price, normalized by the open price.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative downward momentum, providing a bounded continuous feature for SVM hyperplanes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(open - low) / np.maximum(open, 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_volume_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and roughly max-scaled trading volume to compress extreme outliers.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents large volume outliers from dominating the linear SVM margin while preserving the continuous scale of market participation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(volume) / 13.63"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_trade_count_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and roughly max-scaled trade count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, bounded representation of market activity frequency.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(trade_count) / 7.64"
    },
    {
      "name": "volume_per_trade_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed average volume per trade, indicating the average size of market transactions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "liquidity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps the model distinguish between markets driven by many small trades versus a few large trades.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.where(trade_count > 0, volume / trade_count, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "open_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized open price using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-1.5, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "price_level",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the initial price level, which is a fundamental requirement for stable linear SVM convergence.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(open - 0.5287599762087843) / 0.3540544512478701"
    },
    {
      "name": "relative_open_position",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The position of the open price relative to the high-low range, scaled between 0 and 1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "price_dynamics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded, continuous indicator of where the market opened relative to its extremes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((high - low) > 0, (open - low) / (high - low), 0.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_price_spread_to_open",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled ratio of the total price spread relative to the open price.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "volatility",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures relative volatility in a compressed scale, preventing extreme spreads from skewing the linear decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p((high - low) / np.maximum(open, 0.001))"
    },
    {
      "name": "activity_momentum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction feature combining log volume and price range to capture high-activity, high-volatility states.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to capture the non-linear interaction between volume and volatility through a pre-computed composite.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(volume) * (high - low)"
    },
    {
      "name": "liquidity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses the overall liquidity and reliability of the market on a continuous scale from 0 (highly illiquid, untrustworthy signals) to 1 (highly liquid, robust signals) based on the volume and trade count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantic weighting factor that can help the SVM margin discount noisy signals from illiquid markets.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "volatility_regime_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses the volatility regime of the market on a continuous scale from 0 (stable, low volatility) to 1 (chaotic, extreme volatility) based on the spread between high and low relative to the open price.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates raw price movements into a semantic regime score, allowing the linear model to adjust its sensitivity based on market conditions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
